crossRefs.note: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made its pyre deep and large with…
Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

translations.web: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
translations.bsb: His breath sets coals ablaze, and flames pour from his mouth.
translations.kjv: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
translations.asv: His breath kindleth coals, And a flame goeth forth from his mouth.
